title: FSDO: Incident Status Update — UAS-11

transcript.speaker: ASO
transcript.text: Incident Commander, this is the ASO. I have just reported to the FAA FSDO via HUOG-ERP Section 6.2 (FSDO contact: (585) 555-0188). UAS-11 has been landed manually on the meadow. The GCS is quarantined. The fleet of that type is grounded per ISP Section 9.1. The incident is under investigation. The FSDO has been updated on the status and the hold on data transfer.

instructorNote: Confirm FSDO reporting and fleet grounding per ISP Section 9.1 and C3. The team must verify that no further flights are authorized.
